Reviewing, seconds per change by week, lower is faster: %1$s
Reviewing, seconds per change by two weeks, lower is faster: %1$s
Each point is two weeks: most weeks had too few messages.
Messages timed before pauses were capped at 30 seconds are left out.
Send 5 messages of 3 words or more in a week, in the chat.
Speed over time uses only messages written in the chat, of 3 words or more, never estimates. A week needs 5 of them and 30 words to show a point. Under Linguize it shows the language you write most.
Writing in the chat is measured from your first keystroke to Send. Pauses count up to 30 seconds, and nothing counts while the app isn\'t on screen.

Reviewing is measured while a result is on the card, in the chat or over another app, until you send or put the text back. Waiting for the check doesn\'t count, and a card left alone counts up to two minutes.
Writing in other apps can\'t be seen, so it\'s estimated: its words times your own speed in the chat, in that language when there\'s enough, or a typical 4 s a word until there is.
Averages show a typical message (the median), so one slow message doesn\'t skew them. Totals include every message.
Only messages you sent or put back count, and only while History is on. Thinking before you type and reading replies aren\'t counted. Deleting a message from History deletes its time.
Send a message in the chat, or put a checked message back in another app, and the time shows here.
History is off, so new messages aren\'t timed.
